description:
What is This Part?
These are the Suzuki OEM Spacers and Bushings for the front or Rear Leaf springs.
Made by SUZUKI
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 16 – Small Bushings
Qty 8 – Large Bushings
Qty 4 – Spacers
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
